title: FNL Themes for Quarto
text:
This is a Quarto template that assists you in creating a report, document, or presentation using the FNLCR branding guidelines.


To create a new document, use the following command:
quarto use template CCBR/quarto-fnl
This will install the extension and create an example qmd file that you can use as a starting place



You may also use this format with an existing Quarto project or document. From the quarto project or document directory, run the following command to install this format:
quarto install extension CCBR/quarto-fnl



To use the format, you can use the format names fnl-html, fnl-revealjs, or fnl-dashboard. For example:
quarto render report.qmd --to fnl-html
or in your document yaml or _quarto.yml file:
format:
  fnl-html

title: NCI Standard Public Repository Security Policy
text:
Actively maintained versions of contained software will vary from repository to repository, or may not be relevant at all.
The developers of this repository will update this section if any actively maintained versions of the software need to be publicly disclosed. Otherwise, contact the developers directly for any version information.





Follow the instructions listed in the HHS vulnerability disclosure policy.




Click on the Security and quality tab of this repository.
Locate the Report a vulnerability button. If the button is not on the Security and quality landing page, look under the Advisories section in the side bar.
Click the Report a vulnerability button and submit the form. The developers will receive a notification of your submission.
